workflow_pattern: This is a 'F7_pure_automation' style workflow. It requires the following operations, in roughly this order: create repository, add readme with content, create workflow auto close by label, validate automation with test issues. The task should combine these operations into one coherent, realistic request without listing them as separate steps.
question:
Hi! I'm a maintainer working on learning GitHub automation and I really need your help. Could you please help me create a new project repository named stale-issue-closer? I need to initialize it with just the main branch and include an initial README.md file with the content "# Stale Issue Closer

A repository to test GitHub automation for closing labeled issues." I'm struggling with GitHub automation workflows and would really appreciate your help developing a script that automatically closes issues labeled as 'duplicate' or 'invalid'. After we set up the automation script, I need to test it by creating three sample issues with different labels (labels: 'duplicate', title: "Report already tracked elsewhere"; labels: 'invalid', title: "Not a real bug"; labels: 'enhancement', title: "Add dark mode support"). I'm really grateful for any assistance you can provide!
